dominant: adbhuta with vīra weight (wonder at visible proof; the guru's resolve to demonstrate)
sthayibhava: vismaya (astonishment at the burned seed) settling into dhṛti
justification: The ahnika stages marvels — seed sterilized, body lightened, master proven — and each marvel steadies the doubter; the guru's resolve to show (not merely tell) carries the energy, wonder carries the conviction.
